g.text: You carry the standard key ring. Where it does not open a door,
try another route; we concede these buildings are rather old, you
may be able to find other pathways where a key does not open a
particular door. Do not force anything. Everything here is due to
come down regardless, and we are most definitely not paying for a
Check in on the hour by radio.
The prior contractor delivered four accepted room tones. The
packet was settled for four. The account remains open. We want 5
clean recordings, and it seems the fifth was undelivered.
Do not provide supplemental material. Do not annotate the takes.
Do not describe the building. Acceptance is based on clean minutes
